about:
SinnovaTek was founded in 2015 in Raleigh, North Carolina, as a certified B Corporation with a mission to promote global health and wellness through sustainable food processing. The company was built on principles of integrity, creativity, and sustainability, aiming to deliver high-quality, healthy foods via advanced technologies.

The firm develops and manufactures advanced food processing equipment, including thermal processing systems and pumps, while providing R&D and engineering services. It operates a precision-scale aseptic copacking facility (FirstWave Co-Packing) for rapid prototyping and product launches, and offers protein-polyphenol ingredient technology (Vitero) with supporting product development and piloting services. The pilot facility enables small-scale manufacturing to commercialize products without traditional roadblocks.

SinnovaTek serves the food industry, working with both established companies and startups seeking to bring innovative food products to market. Its end-to-end solutions span equipment integration, ingredient technology, and co-manufacturing, targeting forward-thinking food businesses of all sizes.

The company differentiates itself through its B Corp certification, membership in the Upcycled Food Association, and a belief that processed foods can be nutritious and sustainable. It emphasizes making advanced technologies accessible to large and small companies alike, with creative, economical solutions that preserve nutrition and quality.
